textbookText: 19. What is the type of chemical reaction occurring inside the test tube shown in the given figure the balanced chemical equation of that reaction. Ans:- When an iron pin is placed in copper sulfate (CuSO₄) solution inside a test tube, a single displacement reaction takes place. In this reaction, iron (Fe) displaces copper (Cu) from copper sulfate because iron is more reactive than copper. The balanced chemical equation for this is Fe + CuSO4 → FeSO4 + Cu. 20. Samir burns a magnesium ribbon which is like a small strip or a ribbon. It burns brightly and forms ash ‘A’. write the name of substance ‘A’. write a balanced chemical reaction of the process. Ans:- When Samir burns a magnesium ribbon, it reacts with oxygen in the air. The burning produces a bright white flame. After burning, a white ash is formed, which is magnesium oxide. The chemical reaction can be written as: 2Mg + O₂ → 2MgO. In this reaction, magnesium combines with oxygen to form magnesium oxide.

Section ‘D’ Long answer type questions. 1. What happens when solution of silver nitrate is added into the solution of sodium chloride? Write the balanced chemical equation. Which type of chemical reaction is it? Write with reason. Ans:- When a solution of silver nitrate is added to a solution of sodium chloride, a white curdy precipitate of silver chloride is formed immediately, while sodium nitrate remains dissolved in the solution. The balanced chemical equation for the reaction is AgNO₃(aq) + NaCl(aq) → AgCl(s)↓ + NaNO₃(aq) This reaction is a double displacement reaction. It is because the ions of silver nitrate and sodium chloride exchange with each other to form silver chloride and sodium nitrate. Since silver chloride is insoluble in water and separates out as a precipitate, the reaction is also called a precipitation reaction. 2. Explain an experiment in detail to prove that, the rate of chemical reaction increases with the increase in surface area of reactants. Ans:- Experiment to show that the rate of a chemical reaction increases with increase in surface area Aim: To prove that the rate of a chemical reaction increases when the surface area of the reactants is increased. Materials required: Calcium carbonate (marble) in the form of large chips and powdered marble, dilute hydrochloric acid, two conical flasks, corks, delivery tubes, and a gas jar (or balloons). Procedure: Take two conical flasks and label them A and B. Put equal amounts of dilute hydrochloric acid into both flasks. In flask A, add a few large marble chips, and in flask B, add the same mass of powdered marble. Immediately close both flasks with corks fitted with delivery tubes and allow the reaction to take place. Observation: In flask B containing powdered marble, carbon dioxide gas is produced much faster, with brisk effervescence. In flask A containing marble chips, the gas is released slowly and effervescence is less vigorous. Chemical equation: CaCO₃(s) + 2HCl(aq) → CaCl₂(aq) + H₂O(l) + CO₂(g) Conclusion: The reaction occurs faster in flask B because powdered marble has a larger surface area than marble chips. A larger surface area allows more particles of calcium carbonate to come into contact with hydrochloric acid at the same time. Therefore, the rate of a chemical reaction increases with an increase in the surface area of the reactants. 3. Change the given word equations into formula equation. Also, write the type of the chemical reaction. i) Sodium + Chlorine → Sodium Chloride Ans:- The formula equation is 2Na + Cl2 → 2NaCl. This is a combination reaction because two elements combine to form a single compound. ii) Calcium bicarbonate → Calcium carbonate + water + Carbon dioxide Ans:- The formula equation is Ca(HCO₃)₂ → CaCO₃ + H₂O + CO₂. This is a decomposition reaction because one compound breaks down into simpler substances. 4. What happens in the following conditions? Write with balanced chemical equation: i) Copper oxide is treated with dilute Sulphuric acid. Ans:- Copper oxide reacts with dilute sulphuric acid to form copper sulphate and water. The black copper oxide dissolves, producing a blue solution of copper sulphate. Balanced chemical equation is CuO + H₂SO₄ → CuSO₄ + H₂O. ii) Electricity is passed through acidulated water. Ans:- Acidulated water undergoes electrolysis and decomposes into hydrogen and oxygen gases. Hydrogen gas is liberated at the cathode and oxygen gas is liberated at the anode. Balanced chemical equation is 2H₂O(l) → 2H₂(g) + O₂(g). 5. Change the given word equations into formula equation. Also, write the type of the chemical reaction. i) Iron + Oxygen → Ferric oxide Ans:- The formula equation is 4Fe + 3O₂ → 2Fe₂O₃. This is a combination reaction because iron and oxygen combine to form a single compound.
